description: ClusterKeycloakInstance makes a Keycloak server known to the operator at the cluster level

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description:
ClusterKeycloakInstanceSpec defines the desired state of ClusterKeycloakInstance.
It mirrors KeycloakInstanceSpec but is cluster-scoped: secret references must
specify a namespace explicitly.

auth.description:
Auth selects how the operator authenticates to Keycloak.
Exactly one of auth.passwordGrant or auth.clientCredentials must be set.

clientCredentials.description:
ClusterClientCredentialsSpec configures OAuth2 client_credentials
authentication for cluster-scoped instances.

secretRef.description:
ClusterClientCredentialsSecretRefSpec references a client-credentials Secret.
Namespace is required because the resource is cluster-scoped.

passwordGrant.description:
ClusterPasswordGrantSpec configures password-grant authentication
for cluster-scoped instances.

secretRef.description:
ClusterPasswordGrantSecretRefSpec references an admin-credentials Secret.
Namespace is required because the resource is cluster-scoped.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: exactly one of auth.passwordGrant or auth.clientCredentials must be set

baseUrl.description: BaseUrl is the URL of the Keycloak server (e.g., http://keycloak:8080)

realm.description: Realm is the admin realm (defaults to "master")

tls.description: TLS configures how the operator verifies the Keycloak server certificate.

caCert.description:
ClusterCACertSource references a Secret or ConfigMap key containing a
PEM-encoded CA bundle. Exactly one of secretRef or configMapRef must be set.

configMapRef.description: ClusterCACertConfigMapRefSpec is the cluster-scoped variant; namespace required.

secretRef.description: ClusterCACertSecretRefSpec is the cluster-scoped variant; namespace required.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: exactly one of caCert.secretRef or caCert.configMapRef must be set

token.description: Token contains optional token caching configuration

expiresKey.description: ExpiresKey is the key in the secret for the token expiration

secretName.description: SecretName is the name of the secret to cache the token

tokenKey.description: TokenKey is the key in the secret for the token

status.description: ClusterKeycloakInstanceStatus defines the observed state of ClusterKeycloakInstance

conditions.description: Conditions represent the latest available observations

lastTransitionTime.description:

This should be when the underlying condition changed.  If that is not known, then using the time when the API field changed is acceptable.

message.description:

observedGeneration.description:
observedGeneration represents the .metadata.generation that the condition was set based upon.
For instance, if .metadata.generation is currently 12, but the .status.conditions[x].observedGeneration is 9, the condition is out of date
with respect to the current state of the instance.

reason.description:

Producers of specific condition types may define expected values and meanings for this field,
and whether the values are considered a guaranteed API.
The value should be a CamelCase string.
This field may not be empty.

message.description: Message contains additional information about the status

ready.description: Ready indicates if the Keycloak instance is accessible

resourcePath.description: ResourcePath is the API path for this resource

version.description: Version is the Keycloak server version
